injuries.description: muscular sprain of the lumbar spine, recovered with functional deficit
source: muscular sprain of the lumbar spine, recovered with functional deficit, and right middle finger soft tissue sprain, recovered.

injuries.description: right middle finger soft tissue sprain, recovered
source: muscular sprain of the lumbar spine, recovered with functional deficit, and right middle finger soft tissue sprain, recovered.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of finger, unspecified

manifestations.description: tender and swollen right middle finger

treatments_received: Accident & Emergency Department treatment at Queen Mary Hospital
Aberdeen Jockey Club General Out‑Patient Clinic (over 20 attendances from 23 November 2005 to 21 March 2006)
Queen Mary Hospital Specialist Out Patient Clinic follow-up
Referral to Department of Orthopaedics of Queen Mary Hospital
Referral to David Trench Rehabilitation Centre for physiotherapy (received 14 sessions)

Admission to an intensive rehabilitation program at the Duchess of Kent Children’s Hospital (occupational therapy and physiotherapy at the Maclehose Medical Rehabilitation Centre and the Duchess of Kent Children’s Hospital)

losses.description: Pain, suffering and loss of amenities resulting from muscular sprain of the lumbar spine and right middle finger soft tissue sprain (award of $100,000).
